Delete an Employment Type

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to delete an employment type that is no longer needed. Employment types cannot be archived, only deleted.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Employment Types

Click Employment Types.

4. Find the employment type

Type the name of the employment type and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the employment type.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Delete

Click Delete.

8. Confirm

Click Delete in the window to confirm.
